_comment: The two trees. Anything can be bought in any order. Names and most effects are carried over from the earlier build (story bible 2c); 'Old Name' is PROPOSED for the gate conversation. Costs are tuned so there aren't enough nuggets for everything: the talk route takes three Memory skills.

memory.name: Her Handwriting
memory.desc: You know whose hand that is. Letters and notes tell you more.

memory.name: These Walls
memory.desc: You know this flat. You notice when a corridor comes round on itself.

memory.name: Old Name
memory.desc: Somebody used to shout a name at you across rooftops, and you'd turn round. (PROPOSED)

memory.name: How She Moves
memory.desc: You've known her a long time. You can feel where she is when she's close.

memory.name: The Bow
memory.desc: Your shoulders remember drawing it. Things you throw go further, and land where you mean.

memory.name: Counting
memory.desc: A girl's voice, counting, somewhere. You know which way it is.

survival.name: Headshot
survival.desc: A shot to the head kills outright. Anything.

survival.name: Steady Hand
survival.desc: The revolver kicks less and comes back on target faster.

survival.name: Quick Reload
survival.desc: A round into the gate twice as fast.

survival.name: Quiet Feet
survival.desc: You walk like a man who's been somewhere he shouldn't. Footsteps carry half as far.

survival.name: Deep Pockets
survival.desc: Seven more rounds, from a coat pocket you didn't know you had.
